faq.title: Jaguar XK 508PN FAQs
faq.description: Answers about costs, warranty, specification and fitting for the naturally aspirated Jaguar XK 508PN engine.

faqs.q: How much is a Jaguar XK 508PN engine replacement?
faqs.a: It depends on whether you choose a used, reconditioned or rebuilt engine and whether we fit it. Send your registration for an itemised written quote covering parts and labour.

faqs.q: Do your 508PN engines come with a warranty?
faqs.a: Yes. Every engine we supply includes a six-month mechanical warranty. We'll explain exactly what's covered and any conditions, including those for outside fitting, before you order.

faqs.q: Was the 508PN fitted to the 2006 XK?
faqs.a: No. The 2006 XK used a 4.2-litre V8. Parts catalogues list the 508PN in the XK from early 2009, so we confirm your engine code using the VIN.
Catalogues list it at 283kW, or 385PS, which is roughly 380hp. Listings quoting 375hp are likely using a rounded figure, so we confirm specification before supplying an engine.

faqs.q: What are common Jaguar XK 508PN engine problems?
faqs.a: Reported issues include timing chain tensioner wear, water pump and coolant pipe leaks, coil faults and oil seepage. Symptoms can overlap, so diagnosis should come before any repair decision.

faqs.q: Can you deliver a 508PN to my own specialist?
faqs.a: Yes. Supply-only engines are delivered by pallet across the UK to homes or independent garages. We confirm compatibility before dispatch and explain warranty conditions for outside fitting.

faqs.q: What does your XK supply and fit service include?
faqs.a: At our Grays, Essex workshop we remove the failed engine, install the replacement, refill fluids, complete software setup and road test your XK. Timescales are confirmed when we quote.

workshopIntro.title: Repairing or Replacing Your XK's 508PN V8
workshopIntro.description: Get a proper diagnosis before committing to anything. Water pump leaks, coil failures and timing solenoid faults can often be fixed with the engine in place. If chain failure or overheating has caused internal damage, compare the repair figure with your XK's value and condition.
paragraphs: The Jaguar XK 508PN engine replacement cost depends on the engine type, its history and whether fitting is included. Labour on a front-mid-mounted V8 in a grand tourer is significant, so full supply and fit quotes allow the fairest comparison.
When browsing 508PN 5.0 V8 petrol engine UK listings, check whether the unit came from an XK, XF or XJ, plus its mileage and history. Ancillaries can differ, so confirm the details before you buy.

Warranty cover deserves attention too. A Jaguar XK 508PN engine with warranty protects you if a mechanical fault appears after fitting. Engines we supply include a six-month mechanical warranty, and we explain the terms and conditions before you order.

engineProblems.title: Jaguar XK 508PN Engine Problems to Watch
engineProblems.description: These are possible indicators only; diagnosis confirms what is really happening.

cards.title: Rattle Before Warm-Up
cards.description: A metallic rattle in the first seconds after a cold start may point to tired timing chain tensioners or guides.
cards.action: Have the timing gear inspected soon.

cards.title: Coolant Smell or Drips
cards.description: A sweet smell after driving or drips under the front could suggest a leaking water pump or coolant pipe.
cards.action: Request a cooling system pressure test.

cards.title: Gauge Climbing High
cards.description: A temperature gauge reading higher than usual might relate to coolant loss, a thermostat fault or a failing pump.
cards.action: Pull over and let it cool.

cards.title: Cam Timing Fault Codes
cards.description: Warning lights carrying camshaft correlation codes could indicate chain stretch or a faulty variable timing solenoid.

cards.title: Stuttering Acceleration
cards.description: Hesitation, a rough idle or a flashing warning light may be linked to ignition coils, spark plugs or injectors.

cards.title: Oil Marks Underneath
cards.description: Fresh oil spots below the engine or around the cam covers may mean gaskets or seals are beginning to leak.
cards.action: Have the leak found and assessed.

engineOverview.title: The 5.0 V8 That Powers the X150 Jaguar XK
paragraphs: The 508PN is the naturally aspirated 5.0-litre V8 from Jaguar's AJ133 family. Parts catalogues list it in the X150 XK coupé and convertible from early 2009 to mid-2014, rated at 283kW, or 385PS. It uses direct fuel injection and drives the rear wheels through an automatic gearbox.

Because 385PS works out at roughly 380hp, a Jaguar XK 5.0 V8 petrol engine 375hp listing is likely quoting a rounded or approximate figure. The supercharged XKR used the related 508PS, so we always confirm which version your car carries.

Searches for a Jaguar XK 508PN engine 2006 need care. The X150 XK launched in 2006 with a 4.2-litre V8, and the 5.0 only replaced it in 2009. Your VIN tells us which engine the car left the factory with.
